structure.unit: Crimes Against the Administration of Justice

law.catch_line: Cases in which courts and judges may punish summarily for contempt

text.section: The judge shall indicate, in writing, under which subdivision in subsection A a person is being charged and punished for contempt.

Nothing in subdivision A 6 shall be construed to prohibit prosecution under § 19.2-128. The provisions of subdivision A 6 shall not apply to any person who is (i) incarcerated in any correctional facility or (ii) (a) detained in any state or federal facility or (b) in the custody of a law-enforcement officer at the time such person is required to appear before any court or judicial officer.
